title: Kakyuusei
overview:
I want to share the flutter in my heart with you...

You are Kentaro, a third-year student at Uzuki Academy, and over the course of a year you can grow closer to one of thirteen girls around town, from schoolmates to the people you meet day to day.

In this romance simulation, move around a map of the town, choose where to spend your time, talk with the girls and take them on dates. Gifts bought with your money can win hearts faster, but seasonal events only happen if affection is high enough at the right time, and a careless word can lose a girl for good. Characters are fully voiced.

- 1 player
- 3 discs
- For ages 18 and over

心のときめきを、あなたに伝えたい…。
